name: softclip + tone LPF (best)
description: Gold-standard soft saturator with pre-HPF and tone LPF. Clean, low alias.
formula:
// softclip + tone LPF (best)
// Formulas: softclip(x, a) · filter HPF/LPF · y * c
param a = Drive [0.8, 8.0]
param b = Tone [800, 9000]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 55; resonance = 0.3
stage1: y = softclip(x, a)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.4
stage2: y = y * c

name: tube then soft ceiling
description: Asymmetric 12AX7 tube into softclip ceiling + tone LPF.
formula:
// tube then soft ceiling
// Formulas: tube(x, a) · softclip(y, 1.2) · HPF/LPF
param a = Drive [1.2, 8.0]
param b = Tone [600, 6500]
param c = Level [0.35, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 75; resonance = 0.35
stage1: y = tube(x, a)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.5
stage2: y = softclip(y, 1.2) * c

name: hardclip after soft (no crackle)
description: Soft-pre then soft-knee hard ceiling. Always recover with LPF.

name: parallel soft clip
description: Dry/wet blend of softclip for transparent peak control.
formula:
// parallel soft clip
// Formulas: lerp(x, softclip(x, a), b) · LPF
param a = Drive [1.0, 5.0]
param b = Blend [0.15, 0.9]
param c = Level [0.6, 1.15]
stage1: y = lerp(x, softclip(x, a), b) * c
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 14000; resonance = 0.25

name: diode soft clip + LPF
description: asinh diode stack with soft finish and tone LPF.
formula:
// diode soft clip + LPF
// Formulas: diode(x, a) · softclip(y, 1.05) · HPF/LPF
param a = Drive [1.0, 8.0]
param b = Tone [1000, 10000]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 50; resonance = 0.28
stage1: y = diode(x, a)
stage2: y = softclip(y, 1.05) * c
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35

name: bitcrush soft-pre + LPF
description: Soft-pre bitcrush; LPF mandatory after quantize.
formula:
// bitcrush soft-pre + LPF
// Formulas: bitcrush(softclip(x, b), a) · LPF
param a = Bits [3.0, 12.0]
param b = Drive [0.8, 4.0]
param c = LPF [600, 10000]
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, b), a)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.45

name: multi-stage + y_prev (fast)
description: One feedback stage only (SIMD-friendly). Pre tube + regen + LPF.
formula:
// multi-stage + y_prev (fast)
// Formulas: tube · tube(x + y_prev*b) · softclip · LPF
// Note: max ONE stage with y_prev for performance
param a = Drive [1.2, 7.0]
param b = Regen [0.08, 0.48]
param c = Tone [800, 6500]
param d = Level [0.35, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.35
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.55)
stage2: y = tube(x + y_prev * b, a * 0.4)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.45
stage3: y = softclip(y, 1.15) * d

name: EQ 3-band (serial)
description: Serial HPF body / BPF mid scoop-boost / LPF air. Gain via softclip-safe levels.
formula:
// EQ 3-band (serial)
// Formulas: filter HPF · stage gain · filter BPF · stage mid · filter LPF · softclip
// Note: serial EQ (no true parallel bands) — shape spectrum step by step
param a = LowCut [40, 250]
param b = Mid [400, 3500]
param c = High [3000, 14000]
param d = MidGain [0.4, 2.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.35
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.05)
filter2: type = bandpass; center = b; width = b * 0.55
stage2: y = softclip(x * d, 1.1)
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3
stage3: y = softclip(x, 1.02)

name: EQ presence shelf
description: HPF tightness + presence BPF + air LPF. Simple guitar-cab tilt.
formula:
// EQ presence shelf
// Formulas: HPF · BPF presence · lerp(x, mid, amount) · LPF
param a = Tight [50, 200]
param b = Presence [1800, 5500]
param c = Amount [0.15, 0.9]
param d = Air [5000, 14000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.4
filter2: type = bandpass; center = b; width = 1200
stage1: y = lerp(x, softclip(x, 1.2), c)
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = d; resonance = 0.28

name: tilt EQ (dark/bright)
description: One-knob spectral tilt via HPF/LPF balance and soft level.
formula:
// tilt EQ (dark/bright)
// Formulas: HPF(map tilt) · LPF(map tilt) · softclip · level
param a = Tilt [0.0, 1.0]
param b = Level [0.5, 1.3]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 40 + a * 180; resonance = 0.3
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000 - a * 7000; resonance = 0.28
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.05) * b

name: comp glue
description: Broadband compressor + soft makeup. Musical glue bus.
formula:
// comp glue
// Formulas: comp1 · softclip(x * makeup)
param a = Threshold [-36.0, -8.0]
param b = Ratio [1.8, 8.0]
param c = Attack [0.002, 0.04]
param d = Makeup [1.0, 2.8]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = c; release = 0.14
stage1: y = softclip(x * d, 1.1)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 16000; resonance = 0.22

name: comp punch
description: Fast attack / medium release for drums and pick attacks.
formula:
// comp punch
// Formulas: comp (fast atk) · diode makeup
param a = Threshold [-28.0, -6.0]
param b = Ratio [2.5, 10.0]
param c = Makeup [1.0, 2.5]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.003; release = 0.09
stage1: y = diode(x * c, 1.08)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 14000; resonance = 0.25

name: multiband comp (serial spectral)
description: Serial spectral MBC approximation: focus lows → compress → restore air. Not true parallel MBC.
formula:
// multiband comp (serial spectral)
// Formulas: LPF focus · comp · HPF restore · softclip glue
// Note: true parallel multiband needs split/sum (not in DSL) — this is a serial focus chain
param a = Focus [120, 600]
param b = Threshold [-30.0, -8.0]
param c = Ratio [2.0, 8.0]
param d = Air [0.2, 0.85]
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.35
comp1: threshold = b; ratio = c; attack = 0.008; release = 0.16
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.08)
filter2: type = highpass; cutoff = a * 0.85; resonance = 0.3
stage2: y = lerp(x, softclip(x, 1.05), d)

name: env filter + comp
description: RMS envelope opens LPF, then gentle compression.
formula:
// env filter + comp
// Formulas: env1 · filter cutoff = f(env1) · comp · softclip
param a = Base [200, 1200]
param b = Span [800, 6000]
param c = Threshold [-24.0, -8.0]
env1: type = rms; attack = 0.015; release = 0.22
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a + env1 * b; resonance = 0.7
comp1: threshold = c; ratio = 3.0; attack = 0.01; release = 0.15
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.05)

name: gate
description: Hard noise gate via step on abs(x).

name: analog slap delay
description: True delay line slapback: short time, low feedback, damped tails, mild drive.
formula:
// analog slap delay
// Formulas: softclip pre · delay line · tone
param a = Time [40, 180]
param b = Feedback [0.0, 0.45]
param c = Mix [0.1, 0.55]
param d = Damp [1200, 9000]
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.15)
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = d

name: tempo ping-pong
description: Host-synced quarter/eighth delay with stereo ping-pong and damp.
formula:
// tempo ping-pong
// Formulas: softclip · delay(sync, fb, mix, damp, pingpong)
param a = Feedback [0.15, 0.65]
param b = Mix [0.15, 0.55]
param c = Damp [800, 10000]
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.08)
delay1: sync = 1/8; feedback = a; mix = b; damp = c; pingpong = true

name: dub echo
description: Long dark echo with high feedback and low damp cutoff.
formula:
// dub echo
// Formulas: tube pre · long delay · optional LPF polish
param a = Time [250, 900]
param b = Feedback [0.35, 0.85]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.6]
param d = Damp [400, 4500]
stage1: y = tube(x, 1.4)
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = d
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25

name: room reverb
description: Real algorithmic room: multi-comb + allpass (Freeverb-style).
formula:
// room reverb
// Formulas: reverb block (Schroeder/Freeverb)
param a = Size [0.15, 0.75]
param b = Decay [0.2, 0.75]
param c = Damp [0.15, 0.75]
param d = Mix [0.1, 0.55]
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = c; mix = d; width = 0.85

name: hall reverb
description: Larger hall: high size/decay, moderate damp, wide stereo.
formula:
// hall reverb
// Formulas: softclip · reverb large
param a = Size [0.45, 1.0]
param b = Decay [0.4, 0.9]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
param d = Width [0.5, 1.0]
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.05)
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.35; mix = c; width = d

name: plate reverb
description: Brighter plate-ish wash: medium size, lower damp, HPF pre.
formula:
// plate reverb
// Formulas: HPF · reverb (bright damp low)
param a = Size [0.25, 0.7]
param b = Decay [0.3, 0.8]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.55]
param d = Damp [0.05, 0.45]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 160; resonance = 0.28
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = d; mix = c; width = 1.0

name: shimmer verb + trem
description: Reverb into slow tremolo on the wet path character.
formula:
// shimmer verb + trem
// Formulas: reverb · osc AM
param a = Size [0.3, 0.85]
param b = Decay [0.35, 0.8]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.55]
param d = Rate [0.05, 0.5]
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.25; mix = c; width = 0.95
osc1: shape = sine; freq = d; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x * (0.85 + 0.15 * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))

name: tremolo
description: Classic sine tremolo AM.

name: tempo tremolo
description: Host-BPM synced tremolo (soft square available via shape).

name: ring mod
description: Sine ring modulation with depth and level.
formula:
// ring mod
// Formulas: osc · ring (multiply) · LPF
param a = Freq [20.0, 800.0]
param b = Depth [0.2, 1.0]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.2]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - b + b * osc1) * c
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.3

name: auto-wah
description: Envelope-controlled bandpass / lowpass sweep.
formula:
// auto-wah
// Formulas: env peak · LPF(cutoff = f(env)) · softclip
param a = Base [200, 900]
param b = Span [600, 5000]
param c = Res [0.8, 3.5]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.008; release = 0.12
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a + env1 * b; resonance = c
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.15)

name: chorus (delay + dual LFO)
description: Real short delay chorus colour + dual LFO AM thickness.
formula:
// chorus (delay + dual LFO)
// Formulas: short delay · dual LFO AM
param a = Rate [0.2, 3.5]
param b = Depth [0.1, 0.5]
param c = Time [8, 35]
param d = Mix [0.15, 0.55]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0
osc2: shape = sine; freq = a * 1.37; depth = 1.0
delay1: time = c; feedback = 0.12; mix = d; damp = 9000
stage1: y = softclip(x * (1.0 - b + b * 0.5 * ((0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc2))), 1.08)

name: mid/side glue
description: True M/S: encode, compress mid, scale side, decode.
formula:
// mid/side glue
// Formulas: ms encode · mid compress · side level · ms decode
param a = Threshold [-28.0, -10.0]
param b = Ratio [1.5, 5.0]
param c = Side [0.5, 1.4]
ms1: mode = encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.01; release = 0.18
stage2: channel = side; y = softclip(x * c, 1.05)
ms2: mode = decode

name: mid/side width
description: Stereo width control via M/S side gain.
formula:
// mid/side width
// Formulas: ms · side gain · ms decode
param a = Width [0.0, 1.5]
param b = Level [0.7, 1.2]
ms1: mode = encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x * b
stage2: channel = side; y = x * a * b
ms2: mode = decode

name: soft-knee peak ceiling
description: Transparent peak control: softclip pre + hardclip ceiling + LPF.

name: rectify
description: Full-wave rectify for octave-up grit (pair with LPF).

name: studio channel strip
description: HPF → drive → mid EQ → air LPF → glue comp. Six knobs a–f; ratio and level are fixed.
formula:
// studio channel strip
param a = Drive [0.8, 3.5]
param b = LowCut [30, 180]
param c = Mid [400, 3500]
param d = MidGain [0.45, 2.0]
param e = High [4000, 14000]
param f = Thresh [-28.0, -6.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.32
stage1: y = softclip(x, a)
filter2: type = bandpass; center = c; width = c * 0.5
stage2: y = softclip(x * d, 1.12)
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.28
comp1: threshold = f; ratio = 3.0; attack = 0.008; release = 0.15
stage3: y = softclip(x * 1.0, 1.08)

name: dual amp parallel (6 knobs)
description: lerp(tube clean, tube hot) + mid scoop + cab LPF.
formula:
// dual amp parallel (6 knobs)
param a = Clean [0.6, 2.5]
param b = Hot [2.0, 9.0]
param c = Blend [0.2, 0.9]
param d = Scoop [0.3, 1.4]
param e = Cab [2500, 8000]
param f = Level [0.35, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.35
stage1: y = lerp(tube(x, a), tube(x, b), c)
filter2: type = bandpass; center = 900; width = 2200
stage2: y = softclip(x * d, 1.2)
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.4
stage3: y = softclip(y, 1.1) * f

name: rhythmic delay duck
description: Delay + envelope duck + damp + drive on repeats. Six knobs a–f; env times are fixed.
formula:
// rhythmic delay duck
param a = Time [80, 480]
param b = Feedback [0.15, 0.88]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.75]
param d = Damp [800, 9000]
param e = Duck [0.0, 0.9]
param f = Drive [0.8, 4.0]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.008; release = 0.12
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = 1.0; damp = d
stage1: y = softclip(x * (1.0 + f * 0.35), 1.15)
stage2: y = lerp(x, y, c * (1.0 - env1 * e))

name: cinematic reverb
description: Predelay → reverb → air LPF. Six knobs a–f.
formula:
// cinematic reverb
param a = Predelay [20, 180]
param b = Size [0.25, 0.95]
param c = Decay [0.35, 0.92]
param d = Damp [0.15, 0.85]
param e = Mix [0.2, 0.85]
param f = Width [0.4, 1.0]
delay1: time = a; feedback = 0.05; mix = 0.35; damp = 8000
reverb1: size = b; decay = c; damp = d; mix = e; width = f
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8000; resonance = 0.25
stage1: y = softclip(x * 1.0, 1.08)

name: phaser lab
description: LFO bandpass swirl with feedback and mix. Six knobs a–f.
formula:
// phaser lab
param a = Rate [0.05, 6.0]
param b = Depth [200, 2500]
param c = Center [400, 4000]
param d = Feedback [0.05, 0.55]
param e = Mix [0.25, 0.95]
param f = Resonance [0.4, 2.2]
osc1: type = sine; freq = a
filter1: type = bandpass; center = c + osc1 * b; width = 600; resonance = f
stage1: y = softclip(x + y_prev * d, 1.2)
stage2: y = lerp(x, y, e) * 1.0
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.28

name: glitch lab
description: Bitcrush + fold + delay ping-pong + LFO LPF. Always band-limit quantize/fold.
formula:
// glitch lab
param a = Bits [3.0, 12.0]
param b = Fold [0.2, 0.85]
param c = Time [40, 320]
param d = Feedback [0.1, 0.75]
param e = Rate [0.1, 8.0]
param f = Cutoff [400, 9000]
osc1: type = sine; freq = e
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.5), a)
stage2: y = fold(y, -b, b)
delay1: time = c; feedback = d; mix = 0.55; damp = 5000; pingpong = true
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = f + osc1 * f * 0.35; resonance = 0.55
stage3: y = lerp(x, softclip(y, 1.1), 1.0) * 1.0
